text:
anya: heads-up — staging saw a crash when mmap tried to map a compressed safetensors shard. no chunk map emitted.
jon: got it. pipeline gzip flag flipped yesterday?
anya: yep. uploader compressed large shards but didn’t write a v1 chunk map. runtime assumed raw offsets and segfaulted.
sasha: we need a cheap artifact introspection before choosing mmap vs stream. not a full HEAD for every blob.
kevin: agree. minimal design: an optional artifact manifest next to blob, e.g. myshard.safetensors.caps.json. schema small: {"ver":1,"comp":"gzip|none","index_v":0|1,"range_decompress":true|false,"sig":null|"sidecar"}. runtime reads it with a short timeout and caches per artifact-etag.
ellie: fallback semantics: optimistic mmap attempt + validate header. if validate fails, atomically switch to stream-first warmup and mark caps cache for that artifact. avoids blocking on probe in the hot path.
jon: tradeoff: extra probe GET on cold loads. mitigate via cache keyed by etag+model hash and TTL 24h. and allow uploader to emit caps to avoid probe.
sasha: loader API change: BlobResolver.get_tensor_map(tensor) -> union: mmap_descriptor OR segment_list [{blob,off,len,compressed_hint}]. keep serialization compact and avoid nested heavy objects.
kevin: security: never act on caps offsets for mmap until binary signature verified. treat caps as advisory. caps should include signature pointer and signature_state (verified|absent|delegated).
ellie: metrics: caps_fetch, caps_cache_hit, optimistic_mmap_success, mmap_validation_fail, fallback_to_stream, wasted_prefetch_bytes. alert if fallback_to_stream > 1% for model in 1h.
anya: QA: add fuzz harness that truncates headers, toggles caps presence, and injects transparent CDN compression. add chaos test toggling uploader compress flag mid-ingest.
jon: rollout: feature flag REDWOOD_ARTIFACT_INTROSPECT=canary. uploader CLI option --emit-chunk-map to help mmap-heavy workloads.
sasha: tests and loader patch I can co-author. kevin own alerts/runbook. ellie handle uploader CLI.
infra-bot: RFC created: /r/artifact-introspect-and-optimistic-mmap (pinned in #eng-ml). :white_check_mark:
anya: thanks, I'll post the RFC link and a short migration checklist here once the draft lands.
